Whether you’re into anime, video games, cosplay, or just curious...

ScottyCon is Carnegie Mellon University's one and only annual student-run anime/video game convention, hosting a large artist alley, cosplay masquerade, live musical performances, arcade cabinets, LAN tournaments, anime screenings, craft activities, and much more!
Feel free to browse and see what ScottyCon has to offer.
Our interest GBM is on Sept 5th @ 2pm in Wean Hall 5316.
